mapper.sql: WK_USER_LRN_STS AS ( SELECT WS.SBJCT_ID , L.USER_ID , WS.LCTR_WKNO AS WKNO , NVL(MAX(L.PRGRT), 0) AS LRN_PRGRT , MAX(CASE WHEN L.PRGRT >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CMPTN_YN_NUM /* 저장된 주차별 학습상태를 기준으로 판정한다. CMPTN/기존 ATND는 화면상 출석으로 표시한다. */ , MAX( CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(L.LRN_STSCD)) IN ('CMPTN', 'ATND') THEN 3 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(L.LRN_STSCD)) = 'LATE' THEN 2 WHEN UPPER(TRIM(L.LRN_STSCD)) = 'ABSNT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) AS LRN_STS_ORD FROM TB_LMS_BYWKNO_USER_LRN_STS L JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WS ON WS.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID WHERE WS.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} GROUP BY WS.SBJCT_ID, L.USER_ID, WS.LCTR_WKNO )

SBJCT_TERM_STS AS ( SELECT X.SBJCT_ID , CASE WHEN X.END_DTTM IS NOT NULL AND X.END_DTTM < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SMSTR_END_YN FROM ( SELECT S.SBJCT_ID /* 학기 종료 여부는 과목 강의종료일을 우선 적용하고, 없으면 학기기수 강의종료일을 기준으로 판정한다. */ , CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(S.SBJCT_LCTR_EDTTM, '^[0-9]{14}$') THEN S.SBJCT_LCTR_EDTTM WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(SC.SMSTR_CHRT_LCTR_EDTTM, '^[0-9]{14}$') THEN SC.SMSTR_CHRT_LCTR_EDTTM END AS END_DTTM FROM TB_LMS_SBJCT S LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_SMSTR_CHRT SC ON SC.SMSTR_CHRT_ID = S.SMSTR_CHRT_ID WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} ) X )
AND ( NVL(TS.SMSTR_END_YN, 'N') = 'Y' OR ( S.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD IS NOT NULL AND S.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD != '00000000' AND S.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) )
CASE WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 3 THEN 'ATND' WHEN NVL(W.LRN_STS_ORD, 0) = 2 THEN 'LATE' WHEN NVL(TS.SMSTR_END_YN, 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'ABSNT' ELSE 'NOTSTARTED' END

ASMT_TRGT AS ( SELECT ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS ROOT_ASMT_ID , TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID AS TARGET_ASMT_ID , TRGT.USER_ID , ROW_NUMBER() OVER( PARTITION BY ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID, TRGT.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN TRGT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID ) AS RN FROM TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN_TRGT TRGT JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT TRGT_ASMT ON TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = TRGT.ASMT_ID AND TRGT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(TRGT_ASMT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT ROOT_ASMT ON ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_ID = NVL(TRGT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID, TRGT_ASMT.ASMT_ID) AND ROOT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(ROOT_ASMT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND ROOT_ASMT.UP_ASMT_ID IS NULL AND ROOT_ASMT.ASMT_OYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = TRGT_ASMT.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.USER_ID = TRGT.USER_ID AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' AND ATNDLC.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ), ASMT_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ROOT_ASMT_ID) AS ASMT_TOT_CNT FROM ASMT_TRGT WHERE RN = 1 GROUP BY USER_ID ), ASMT_SUB AS ( SELECT T.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT T.ROOT_ASMT_ID) AS ASMT_SBMSN_CNT FROM ASMT_TRGT T JOIN TB_LMS_ASMT_SBMSN S ON S.ASMT_ID = T.TARGET_ASMT_ID AND S.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND S.SBMSN_DTTM IS NOT NULL WHERE T.RN = 1 GROUP BY T.USER_ID ), QA_STATS AS ( SELECT A.USER_ID , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.UP_ATCL_ID IS NULL AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS QA_REG_CNT , COUNT(CASE WHEN A.UP_ATCL_ID IS NOT NULL AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS QA_ANS_CNT FROM TB_LMS_BBS_ATCL A JOIN TB_LMS_BBS B ON B.BBS_ID = A.BBS_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.BBS_TYCD = 'QNA' AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' GROUP BY A.USER_ID ), TALK_STATS AS ( SELECT C.USER_ID , COUNT(*) AS TALK_REPLY_CNT FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT C JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A ON A.DSCS_ATCL_ID = C.DSCS_ATCL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS D ON D.DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID WHERE D.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(C.DELYN,'N') = 'N' GROUP BY C.USER_ID ), QUIZ_BASE AS ( SELECT B.EXAM_BSC_ID , D.EXAM_DTL_ID FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_BSC_ID = B.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.EXAM_TYCD = 'QUIZ' AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(D.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ), QUIZ_TRGT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT QB.EXAM_BSC_ID , A.USER_ID FROM QUIZ_BASE QB JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR G WHERE G.EXAM_DTL_ID = QB.EXAM_DTL_ID )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT QB.EXAM_BSC_ID , M.USER_ID FROM QUIZ_BASE QB JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_TRGTR G ON G.EXAM_DTL_ID = QB.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ), QUIZ_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT EXAM_BSC_ID) AS QUIZ_TOT_CNT FROM QUIZ_TRGT GROUP BY USER_ID ), QUIZ_SUB AS ( SELECT QT.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT QT.EXAM_BSC_ID) AS QUIZ_SBMSN_CNT FROM QUIZ_TRGT QT JOIN QUIZ_BASE QB ON QB.EXAM_BSC_ID = QT.EXAM_BSC_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM T ON T.EXAM_DTL_ID = QB.EXAM_DTL_ID AND T.USER_ID = QT.USER_ID AND NVL(T.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND T.TKEXAM_CMPTNYN = 'Y' GROUP BY QT.USER_ID ), SRVY_TRGT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT S.SRVY_ID AS ROOT_SRVY_ID , S.SRVY_ID AS TARGET_SRVY_ID , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY S JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = S.SBJCT_ID AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE S.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND S.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND S.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(S.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_SRVY SUB WHERE SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = S.SRVY_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUB.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT ROOT.SRVY_ID AS ROOT_SRVY_ID , SUB.SRVY_ID AS TARGET_SRVY_ID , M.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_SRVY ROOT JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY SUB ON SUB.UP_SRVY_ID = ROOT.SRVY_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(SUB.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_TRGT G ON G.SRVY_ID = SUB.SRVY_ID JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID AND T.TEAM_CPST_CMPTNYN = 'Y' JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = G.TEAM_ID JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = ROOT.SBJCT_ID AND A.USER_ID = M.USER_ID AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' WHERE ROOT.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND ROOT.SRVY_GBNCD = 'LCTR_SRVY' AND ROOT.UP_SRVY_ID IS NULL AND NVL(ROOT.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(ROOT.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' ), SRVY_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ROOT_SRVY_ID) AS SRVY_TOT_CNT FROM SRVY_TRGT GROUP BY USER_ID ), SRVY_SUB AS ( SELECT T.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT T.ROOT_SRVY_ID) AS SRVY_SBMSN_CNT FROM SRVY_TRGT T JOIN TB_LMS_SRVY_PTCP P ON P.SRVY_ID = T.TARGET_SRVY_ID AND P.USER_ID = T.USER_ID AND P.PTCP_EDTTM IS NOT NULL GROUP BY T.USER_ID ), DSCS_TRGT AS ( SELECT DISTINCT D.DSCS_ID AS ROOT_DSCS_ID , CASE WHEN D.DSCS_UNIT_TYCD = 'TEAM' THEN SUB.DSCS_ID ELSE D.DSCS_ID END AS TARGET_DSCS_ID , A.USER_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS D JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC A ON A.SBJCT_ID = D.SBJCT_ID AND A.AUDITYN = 'N' AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM T ON T.TEAM_GRP_ID = D.TEAM_GRP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_TEAM_MBR M ON M.TEAM_ID = T.TEAM_ID AND M.USER_ID = A.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS SUB ON SUB.UP_DSCS_ID = D.DSCS_ID AND SUB.TEAM_ID = T.TEAM_ID AND NVL(SUB.DELYN,'N') = 'N' WHERE D.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND D.UP_DSCS_ID IS NULL AND NVL(D.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND ( NVL(D.DSCS_UNIT_TYCD, 'GNRL') != 'TEAM' OR SUB.DSCS_ID IS NOT NULL ) ), DSCS_TOT AS ( SELECT USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT ROOT_DSCS_ID) AS DSCS_TOT_CNT FROM DSCS_TRGT GROUP BY USER_ID ), DSCS_SUB AS ( SELECT X.USER_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT X.ROOT_DSCS_ID) AS DSCS_SBMSN_CNT FROM ( SELECT T.USER_ID , T.ROOT_DSCS_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A JOIN DSCS_TRGT T ON T.TARGET_DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID AND T.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT T.USER_ID , T.ROOT_DSCS_ID FROM TB_LMS_DSCS_CMNT C JOIN TB_LMS_DSCS_ATCL A ON A.DSCS_ATCL_ID = C.DSCS_ATCL_ID JOIN DSCS_TRGT T ON T.TARGET_DSCS_ID = A.DSCS_ID AND T.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(C.DELYN,'N') = 'N' ) X GROUP BY X.USER_ID ), EXAM_SCR AS ( SELECT T.USER_ID , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS MID_LIVE_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'Y' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS MID_ALT_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD = 'EXAM_MID' AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD,'X') != 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS MID_ETC_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD = 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS FINAL_LIVE_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'Y' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS FINAL_ALT_SCORE , MAX( CASE WHEN B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(D.REEXAMYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.TKEXAM_MTHD_CD,'X') != 'RLTM' THEN R.TOT_SCR END ) AS FINAL_ETC_SCORE FROM TB_LMS_TKEXAM T JOIN TB_LMS_TKEXAM_RSLT R ON R.TKEXAM_ID = T.TKEXAM_ID AND R.USER_ID = T.USER_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_DTL D ON D.EXAM_DTL_ID = T.EXAM_DTL_ID JOIN TB_LMS_EXAM_BSC B ON B.EXAM_BSC_ID = D.EXAM_BSC_ID WHERE B.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND B.EXAM_GBNCD IN ('EXAM_MID','EXAM_LST','EXAM_LST_TEAM') AND NVL(B.DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND NVL(B.USEYN,'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY T.USER_ID )
mapper.select:
WITH , , CURRENT_WK AS ( SELECT MAX(LCTR_WKNO) AS CURR_WKNO FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD IS NOT NULL AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD != '00000000' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ), WK_ROW AS ( SELECT U.USER_ID , S.LCTR_WKNO AS WK_NO , AS ATND_STS FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC E JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = E.USER_ID CROSS JOIN CURRENT_WK CW JOIN SBJCT_TERM_STS TS ON TS.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL S ON S.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N'
LEFT JOIN WK_USER_LRN_STS W ON W.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND W.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND W.WKNO = S.LCTR_WKNO WHERE E.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND U.USER_ID = #{userId} AND E.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ), WK_AGG AS ( SELECT USER_ID , SUM(CASE WHEN ATND_STS = 'ATND' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ATND_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN ATND_STS = 'LATE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LATE_CNT , SUM(CASE WHEN ATND_STS = 'ABSNT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ABSN_CNT FROM WK_ROW GROUP BY USER_ID ),
SELECT NVL(O.ORGNM, '-') AS ORG_NM , U.USERNM AS USERNM , U.STDNT_NO AS STDNT_NO , U.USER_ID AS USER_ID , ( SELECT MAX(C.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT C WHERE C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND C.CNTCT_TYCD = 'MBL_PHN' ) AS MOBILE_NO , CASE WHEN U.USE_EML_GBNCD = 'LNKG' THEN ( SELECT MAX(C.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT C WHERE C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND C.CNTCT_TYCD = 'LNKG_EML' ) WHEN U.USE_EML_GBNCD = 'INDV' THEN ( SELECT MAX(C.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT C WHERE C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND C.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' ) ELSE COALESCE( ( SELECT MAX(C.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT C WHERE C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND C.CNTCT_TYCD = 'LNKG_EML' ), ( SELECT MAX(C.CNTCT) FROM TB_LMS_USER_CNTCT C WHERE C.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND C.CNTCT_TYCD = 'INDV_EML' ) ) END AS EMAIL , U.PHOTO_FILE_ID AS PHOTO_FILE_ID , A.SBJCTNM AS SBJCTNM , TO_CHAR(A.DVCLAS_NO) AS DVCLAS_NO , A.WHOL_WK_CNT AS WK_CNT , NVL(WA.ATND_CNT, 0) AS ATND_CNT , NVL(WA.LATE_CNT, 0) AS LATE_CNT , NVL(WA.ABSN_CNT, 0) AS ABSN_CNT , NVL(QA.QA_ANS_CNT, 0) AS QA_ANS_CNT , NVL(QA.QA_REG_CNT, 0) AS QA_REG_CNT , NVL(TK.TALK_REPLY_CNT, 0) AS TALK_REPLY_CNT , NVL(ASB.ASMT_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS ASMT_SBMSN_CNT , NVL(AT.ASMT_TOT_CNT, 0) AS ASMT_TRGT_CNT , NVL(QS.QUIZ_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS QUIZ_SBMSN_CNT , NVL(QT.QUIZ_TOT_CNT, 0) AS QUIZ_TRGT_CNT , NVL(SS.SRVY_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS SRVY_SBMSN_CNT , NVL(ST2.SRVY_TOT_CNT, 0) AS SRVY_TRGT_CNT , NVL(DS.DSCS_SBMSN_CNT, 0) AS DSCS_SBMSN_CNT , NVL(DT.DSCS_TOT_CNT, 0) AS DSCS_TRGT_CNT , ES.MID_LIVE_SCORE AS MID_LIVE_SCORE , ES.MID_ALT_SCORE AS MID_ALT_SCORE , ES.MID_ETC_SCORE AS MID_ETC_SCORE , ES.FINAL_LIVE_SCORE AS FINAL_LIVE_SCORE , ES.FINAL_ALT_SCORE AS FINAL_ALT_SCORE , ES.FINAL_ETC_SCORE AS FINAL_ETC_SCORE , NULL AS WK_NO , NULL AS ATND_STS FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC E JOIN TB_LMS_SBJCT A ON A.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID JOIN TB_LMS_USER U ON U.USER_ID = E.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_ORG O ON O.ORG_ID = #{orgId} LEFT JOIN WK_AGG WA ON WA.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ASMT_TOT AT ON AT.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN ASMT_SUB ASB ON ASB.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN QA_STATS QA ON QA.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN TALK_STATS TK ON TK.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN QUIZ_TOT QT ON QT.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN QUIZ_SUB QS ON QS.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SRVY_TOT ST2 ON ST2.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SRVY_SUB SS ON SS.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN DSCS_TOT DT ON DT.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN DSCS_SUB DS ON DS.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN EXAM_SCR ES ON ES.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE E.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND E.USER_ID = #{userId} AND E.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' AND NVL(A.DELYN,'N') = 'N'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_USER_AUTHRT UA WHERE UA.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND UA.ORG_ID = #{orgId} )

WITH , , CURRENT_WK AS ( SELECT MAX(LCTR_WKNO) AS CURR_WKNO FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WHERE SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND NVL(DELYN,'N') = 'N' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD IS NOT NULL AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD != '00000000' AND LCTR_WKNO_SYMD <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') ) SELECT S.LCTR_WKNO AS WK_NO , AS ATND_STS FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC E CROSS JOIN CURRENT_WK CW JOIN SBJCT_TERM_STS TS ON TS.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL S ON S.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND NVL(S.DELYN,'N') = 'N'
LEFT JOIN WK_USER_LRN_STS W ON W.USER_ID = E.USER_ID AND W.SBJCT_ID = E.SBJCT_ID AND W.WKNO = S.LCTR_WKNO WHERE E.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND E.USER_ID = #{userId} AND E.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ORDER BY S.LCTR_WKNO

WITH DAYS AS ( SELECT LEVEL AS DAY FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= TO_NUMBER( TO_CHAR(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM')), 'DD') ) ), STDNT_CURR AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 7, 2)) AS DAY , COUNT(*) AS STDNT_CNT FROM TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV L WHERE L.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 1, 6) = #{yyyymm} GROUP BY SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 7, 2) ), ALL_CURR AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 7, 2)) AS DAY , ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT A.USER_ID) FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ), 0), 1) AS AVG_CNT FROM TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV L WHERE L.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 1, 6) = #{yyyymm} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A WHERE A.SBJCT_ID = L.SBJCT_ID AND A.USER_ID = L.USER_ID AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' ) GROUP BY SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 7, 2) ), PREV_CURR AS ( SELECT TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 7, 2)) AS DAY , COUNT(*) AS PREV_CNT FROM TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV L WHERE L.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 1, 6) = TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{yyyymm}, 'YYYYMM'), -1), 'YYYYMM') GROUP BY SUBSTR(L.ACTV_DTTM, 7, 2) ) SELECT D.DAY AS DAY , NVL(P.PREV_CNT, 0) AS PREV_CNT , NVL(S.STDNT_CNT, 0) AS STDNT_CNT , NVL(A.AVG_CNT, 0) AS AVG_CNT , #{yyyymm} AS YYYYMM FROM DAYS D LEFT JOIN STDNT_CURR S ON S.DAY = D.DAY LEFT JOIN ALL_CURR A ON A.DAY = D.DAY LEFT JOIN PREV_CURR P ON P.DAY = D.DAY ORDER BY D.DAY

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY L.ACTV_DTTM DESC) AS LINE_NO , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(L.ACTV_DTTM,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS ACT_DTTM , L.USER_REQ_URL AS ACT_CONTS , NVL(L.CNTN_BRWSR, L.REQ_TYCD) AS DEVICE_NM , L.CNTN_IP AS IP_ADDR FROM TB_LMS_LOG_USER_ACTV L WHERE L.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_LMS_ATNDLC A WHERE A.USER_ID = L.USER_ID AND A.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND A.ATNDLC_STSCD = 'APPROVE' )
AND ( L.USER_REQ_URL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NVL(L.CNTN_BRWSR, L.REQ_TYCD) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR L.CNTN_IP LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY L.ACTV_DTTM DESC

WITH ,
SELECT WS.LCTR_WKNO AS WK_NO , MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID) AS LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID , CASE WHEN NVL(MAX(W.LRN_STS_ORD), 0) = 3 THEN 'ATND' WHEN NVL(MAX(W.LRN_STS_ORD), 0) = 2 THEN 'LATE' WHEN NVL(MAX(TS.SMSTR_END_YN), 'N') = 'Y' THEN 'ABSNT' ELSE 'NOTSTARTED' END AS ATND_STS , SUM(NVL(A.TOT_MNTS, 0)) AS IN_PRD_LRN_MIN , 0 AS IN_PRD_LRN_SEC , SUM(NVL(A.OTSDPRD_LRN_MNTS, 0)) AS AFT_PRD_LRN_MIN , 0 AS AFT_PRD_LRN_SEC , SUM(NVL(A.TOT_MNTS, 0) + NVL(A.OTSDPRD_LRN_MNTS, 0)) AS TOTAL_LRN_MIN , CASE WHEN MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD) != '00000000' AND SUBSTR(MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD), 5, 4) != '0000' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_SYMD), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') ELSE '-' END AS LRN_ST_DT , CASE WHEN MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD) IS NOT NULL AND MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD) != '00000000' AND SUBSTR(MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD), 5, 4) != '0000' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(MAX(WS.LCTR_WKNO_EYMD), 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY.MM.DD') ELSE '-' END AS LRN_END_DT , TRUNC(MAX(NVL(WS.LCTR_TOC_LRN_SCNDS, 0)) / 60) AS TOT_DUR_MIN , NULL AS LRN_MTHD FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL WS JOIN SBJCT_TERM_STS TS ON TS.SBJCT_ID = WS.SBJCT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_BYWKNO_USER_LRN_STS A ON A.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = WS.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND A.USER_ID = #{userId} LEFT JOIN WK_USER_LRN_STS W ON W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND W.SBJCT_ID = WS.SBJCT_ID AND W.WKNO = WS.LCTR_WKNO WHERE WS.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND WS.LCTR_WKNO = #{wkNo} AND NVL(WS.DELYN,'N') = 'N' GROUP BY WS.LCTR_WKNO

SELECT L.LCTR_ID AS CHSI_SCHDL_ID , L.LCTR_SEQNO AS CHSI_NO , L.LCTRNM AS CHSI_TITLE , C.LCTR_CONTS_ID AS CNTNTS_ID , C.CONTSNM AS CNTNTS_TITLE , '동영상' AS CNTNTS_TYPE_NM , CASE WHEN NVL(H.CONTS_LRN_PRGRT, 0) >= 100 THEN '학습완료' WHEN NVL(H.CONTS_LRN_PRGRT, 0) > 0 THEN '학습중' ELSE '미학습' END AS LRN_STS , NVL(C.ATNDC_RFLTYN, 'N') AS ATND_TRGT_YN , CASE WHEN NVL(H.CONTS_LRN_PRGRT, 0) >= 100 THEN '학습완료' WHEN NVL(H.CONTS_LRN_PRGRT, 0) > 0 THEN '학습중' ELSE '미학습' END AS SCORE_TEXT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(H.CONTS_LRN_SDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS LRN_ST_DT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(H.CONTS_LRN_EDTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI') AS LRN_END_DT , NVL(H.CONTS_LRN_TOT_MNTS, 0) AS LRN_MIN FROM TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND NVL(L.DELYN,'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C ON C.LCTR_ID = L.LCTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS_LRN_HSTRY H ON H.LCTR_CONTS_ID = C.LCTR_CONTS_ID AND H.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND W.LCTR_WKNO = #{wkNo} AND NVL(W.DELYN,'N') = 'N' ORDER BY L.LCTR_SEQNO ASC, C.CONTS_SEQNO ASC

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY LOG.REG_DTTM DESC) AS LINE_NO , LOG.LCTR_CONTS_ID AS CNTNTS_ID , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(LOG.REG_DTTM, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), 'YYYY.MM.DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LOG_DTTM , '[' || NVL(LOG.LRN_RND_CNT, 1) || '] ' || NVL(LOG.LRN_MNTS, 0) || '분' AS PLAY_POS , NVL(LOG.LRN_BRWSR_INFO, '-') AS ACT_INFO , NVL(LOG.RGTR_IP, '-') AS IP_ADDR FROM TB_LMS_LOG_LCTR_CONTS_LRN LOG JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_CONTS C ON C.LCTR_CONTS_ID = LOG.LCTR_CONTS_ID JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR L ON L.LCTR_ID = C.LCTR_ID AND NVL(L.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL W ON W.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID = L.LCTR_WKNO_SCHDL_ID AND NVL(W.DELYN, 'N') = 'N' WHERE LOG.LCTR_CONTS_ID = #{cntntsId} AND LOG.USER_ID = #{userId} AND W.SBJCT_ID = #{sbjctId} AND W.LCTR_WKNO = #{wkNo} ORDER BY LOG.REG_DTTM DESC
